subject: Req87: Recommendation to Repurpose Role + Closeout Plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Recruiting Ops <recruiting@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Req87: Recommendation to repurpose role + closeout plan

Team —

Thanks for joining the hiring committee review last week. After collating interview feedback (attached) and reviewing market signals, I recommend we close Req87 as currently scoped — "Senior Infra Engineer (Growth)" — and repurpose the headcount toward a Principal Backend Engineer (Platform) with a concurrent change in compensation band. Short rationale:

- Interview pipeline: 18 screens, 5 onsite/technical loops, none met the bar on system design and cross-team ownership; two candidates withdrew citing competing offers.
- Market band mismatch: the current band is too narrow for candidates with the Platform ownership profile we actually need.
- Product reprioritization: Product leadership has confirmed one high-impact initiative that needs Platform ownership rather than Growth-specific infra work.

Proposal (high level):
- Close Req87 as "no hire" in its present form.
- Reclassify and open a new req (proposed Req133) for Principal Backend — band: L6/L7 banding discussion below.
- Transfer the headcount commitment and the remaining recruiting budget to Req133.
- Notify recruiting to pause active candidate conversations for Req87 and begin a targeted search for the new profile.

Attached are the interview summary (req87-interview-notes.pdf) and the annotated committee minutes (hiring-committee-minutes-20261116.docx).

Please reply with objections or record approval by EOD Wednesday so we can coordinate recruiting and finance before the next payroll cut.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek — I support the recommendation in principle but want to flag two items before we finalize:

1) Compensation banding: moving to L6/L7 will need Finance sign-off given the difference in target comp and equity budget. Can Recruiting provide a compensation estimate and a suggested offer range for Req133? We should include a band exception request template if needed.

2) Candidate commitments: we have one late-stage candidate (Patricia Gomez) who completed her final loop last week and is waiting on feedback. If we close Req87, we should pause outreach but also send a prompt follow-up to set proper expectations. I don't want to leave a candidate in limbo.

If no objections, I'll coordinate with Recruiting and Finance to get the band estimate and a draft band-exception memo.

Laura Bennett
Dir., Product Recruiting
Redwood Inference

+1 to Laura's asks. A couple of practical notes from Eng: 
- If we repurpose the role, I'd like to reserve 0.5 FTE of the headcount to cover short-term growth infra fixes (we can backfill from team rotation) while we recruit for the principal role. That helps us keep momentum on customer-facing backfill work.
- We should capture the transition plan in the req description so recruiting can target PM and infra-adjacent candidates who can grow into the Principal profile.

I'm OK with closing Req87 as scoped, provided Recruiting sends the comp estimates and we communicate with Patricia today.

Marcus Lin

Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Req87: Recommendation to repurpose role + closeout plan

Thanks all — moving forward with the proposed approach. Summary of decisions (for tracking):

- Req87 will be closed as "no hire (repurpose)" effective 2026-11-18. Recruiting: please pause active outreach and archive current candidate material.
- New req (Req133) approved to be opened for Principal Backend Engineer (Platform). Recruiting/Finance: please provide proposed L6/L7 band ranges and net hiring budget change by EOD Friday (2026-11-20).
- Short-term coverage: Marcus to allocate 0.5 FTE from Growth Platforms for critical infra fixes; Marcus to send a brief rotation plan to Recruiting and Eng Ops by Monday.
- Candidate communications: Laura to send an outreach note to Patricia Gomez today (cc: hiring team) offering feedback and clarifying that we are repurposing the role and will follow up if a new fit emerges.
- Org update: People Ops to receive the closeout memo so headcount records are updated (cc'd Finance).

No objections logged in-thread. Vivek, can you sign off on the final closeout memo and enqueue the Req133 draft in Greenhouse? Once recruiting posts Req133 we can run a targeted search.

Thanks — I'll send a short update to Exec and People Ops after we have Finance's band ranges.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Hiring Committee Chair / Group Manager, Growth
Redwood Inference

Hi Patricia —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with us last week. I wanted to share a quick update: we've decided to repurpose Req87 to better align with our immediate platform needs. That means we are pausing active hiring for the current role. We really appreciated your time and will keep your profile on file; if the new Principal Backend role looks like a fit, we'd love to re-engage. If you'd like feedback from your loop, I'm happy to share a short summary.

Best,
Laura

Redwood Inference
